snippet.title: When UBI Gets Passed But Your Landlord Immediately Raises Rent
snippet.description:
Universal Basic Income sounds great on paper... until rent inflation instantly takes every last cent! 💸🏠

In this clip from BoomER Ville Land, watch what happens during rent collection when UBI hits the board.

🎮 Play BoomER Ville Land on itch.io: https://your-game-link.itch.io/

BoomER Ville Land is a satirical browser board game about modern economic chaos, housing market absurdity, inflation, and boomer advice.
